snippet.title: Shipping Store Simulator 2037 - Launch Trailer | Out Now on Steam
snippet.description:
Shipping Store Simulator 2037, the management sim with robotic employees, is now available on Steam!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/4098030/Shipping_Store_Simulator_2037?utm_source=YT&utm_campaign=releasetrailer

Open up Rocket Post, a package pickup point with a modest budget trying to compete with Quickbox, which dominates the delivery industry in the city of Cranelock. But with a can-do attitude, and an army of robotic employees, Rocket Post can become the premier delivery service for the bustling metropolis. 

Assign automatons to handle key tasks at Rocket Post while balancing the budget and finding new opportunities to expand. Start by managing deliveries, organizing packages, and cleaning while building out the fleet of robotic employees. As staffing increases, the robots can take over more and more tasks while Rocket Post expands its services.

Learn more: https://say.games/games/shipping-store-simulator-2037
